audit_items.code_excerpt: foreach (byte[] requests in flatEncodedRequests) { if (requests.Length <= 1) continue; concatenatedHashes.AddRange(SHA256.HashData(requests)); } return new Hash256(SHA256.HashData(concatenatedHashes...));

phase3_classification.residual_risk: LOW - Standard cryptographic construction with verified library
